[[File:2022 Bespin Regional.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Players at the 2022 Bespin Regionals. Photo: Sam Tashima.]]
The '''2022 Bespin Regionals''' were a Players Committee regional championship on 13 August 2022 in South Saint Paul, Minnesota. [[Sam Tashima]] organized the event and won it. 16 players entered.<ref name="ss22">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/swccgsupersaturday-wrap-up/ #SWCCGSuperSaturday Wrap-up], starwarsccg.org (16 August 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20220818065215/https://www.starwarsccg.org/swccgsupersaturday-wrap-up/ Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pc22">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-06-2022-regional-championship-events/ 2022 Regional Championships], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021002231/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2022-06-2022-regional-championship-events.html Internet Archive].</ref>
